experiments.hypothesis: Evidence-led synthetic fixtures can qualify detection, diagnosis, safe recommendations, and abstention separately.
experiments.baseline: No prior versioned KENN fixture benchmark
experiments.method: Five deterministic numpy/scipy fixtures with controlled ground truth
experiments.result: 1.0 detection/evidence/diagnosis/safety; 0.0 severity MAE, unnecessary processing, unsupported claims, and healthy false positives
experiments.conclusion: Harness is useful; coverage must expand before product claims.

experiments.hypothesis: A simple phase-vocoder reconstruction can preserve duration while improving timbre proxies over resampling.
experiments.method: resampling baseline versus duration-restored phase-vocoder prototype
experiments.result: PV duration error 0.0 s versus 0.5 s baseline, but pitch error 32.3 Hz versus 18.1 Hz and no material centroid-drift improvement
experiments.conclusion: Duration preservation alone is not a quality win; do not promote prototype.

experiments.hypothesis: Typed evidence and plan objects can support useful launch research without external side effects.
experiments.method: Dataclass planner with evidence-kind separation and external-write assertion
experiments.result: Plan emitted; 0 external writes; all five evidence kinds represented
experiments.conclusion: Design/prototype ready; schema and provenance are next.
